prompt_md: Ten friends each flip a coin. Anyone with tails flips again next round; anyone with heads is done. On average, how many rounds until everyone has heads?
prompt_short: 10 coins, reflip the tails each round. Average rounds to all heads?
hint_md: The game lasts as long as the slowest of the ten coins.
explain_intuition_md: Each coin needs 2 flips on average, so 2 rounds sounds right. But the game waits for the unluckiest of the ten. About half the coins are left after one round, a quarter after two, an eighth after three, so it takes several rounds to whittle ten down to none.
